name: Knöfli
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Add gradually to one cup flour mixed and sifted with one teaspoon salt
Place colander over a kettle of boiling water
Force through colander into water, using a potato masher
As soon as buttons come to top of water, remove with skimmer to hot vegetable dish
Sprinkle with salt and grated cheese
Let stand in oven five minutes

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat two eggs slightly
2. Add one-fourth cup milk
3. Add gradually to one cup flour mixed and sifted with one teaspoon salt
4. Place colander over a kettle of boiling water
5. Turn in one-third mixture
6. Force through colander into water, using a potato masher
7. As soon as buttons come to top of water, remove with skimmer to hot vegetable dish
8. Sprinkle with salt and grated cheese
9. Repeat until mixture is used
10. Let stand in oven five minutes
11. Serve
